tasks.name: Create basic frontend layout
tasks.description: Design a single-page layout with a text input field and a save button.

tasks.name: Implement text input functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to type text into the input field.

tasks.name: Set up backend server
tasks.description: Create a backend server to handle saving notes.

tasks.name: Create API endpoint for saving notes
tasks.description: Develop an API endpoint to receive and store notes from the frontend.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Integrate the frontend with the backend API to send notes for saving.

tasks.name: Set up database for storing notes
tasks.description: Create a database schema to store user notes.

tasks.name: Integrate database with backend
tasks.description: Connect the backend server to the database for saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Test text input and save functionality
tasks.description: Ensure that users can input text and save it successfully.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a hosting platform for user access.

T1.implementation_approach: Use HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript to create a responsive layout with sections for input and displaying notes.

T2.implementation_approach: Add an input field and button using JavaScript to capture user text input.
T2.notes: Validate input to prevent empty submissions.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a Node.js server using Express to handle requests.
T3.notes: Install necessary dependencies like Express and configure basic routes.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a POST API endpoint in the backend to receive and save notes data.
T4.notes: Use JSON format for data transfer.

T5.implementation_approach: Use fetch or Axios in the frontend to send user input to the backend API.
T5.notes: Handle success and error responses appropriately.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database like MongoDB or SQLite to store notes with fields for content and timestamps.
T6.notes: Ensure the database is properly configured and connected.

T7.implementation_approach: Integrate the database with the backend by connecting the API endpoint to database operations.
T7.notes: Use an ORM or database driver for efficient queries.

T8.implementation_approach: Test the entire flow from text input to saving notes in the database using manual and automated tests.
T8.notes: Check for edge cases like empty inputs or server errors.

T9.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, Vercel, or AWS.
T9.notes: Ensure environment variables and database connections are properly configured.
